QuestInfo.name: Baby Chick, do you know where Baby Pink Panda's house is?
QuestInfo.0: The Chick doesn't seem to know much about Pink Panda either. Ask Mama Chicken.
QuestInfo.1: Mama chicken seems pretty... violent. You'd better put on the Chicken Smackaroo costume to get any sort of answer.
QuestInfo.2: You put on all pieces of the Chicken Smackaroo set and talked to the Chicken family. They promised that they'll talk to the Panda family! Now head back to Baby Pink Panda.
